documents.title: Chapter 3: the water cycle
documents.content: Chapter 3: the water cycle. Evaporation is water turning from liquid to vapour, mostly from the oceans. Clouds form when water vapour cools and condenses into droplets. Precipitation is water falling as rain, snow or hail. Infiltration is water soaking into the ground. (Page 42 has a nice photo.)
